d:
Touching the pinnacle of sensitive melody, Ilahi is a catchy song in the melodious voice of Arijit Singh from the movie "Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani" starring Ranbir Kapoor, Deepika Padukone, Aditya Roy Kapur, Kalki Koechlin.
Song: Ilahi
Singer: Arijit Singh
Music: Pritam
Lyrics: Amitabh Bhattacharya
Music Label: T-Series
